question: Karthikeyan Murali is associated with which of the following sports?
solution:
The correct answer is __**chess**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In October 2023, 24-year-old Indian Grandmaster Karthikeyan Murali defeated Magnus Carlsen, the former World Chess Champion from Norway, in a highly significant chess match.
 
• Magnus Carlsen, widely regarded as one of the greatest chess players in history, held the World Chess Championship title from 2013 to 2023.
 
• His victory over Carlsen is an extraordinary achievement for Murali, considering Carlsen's dominance in the world of chess for over a decade.
 
• Murali's triumph over Carlsen in such a high-profile event demonstrated his exceptional skills, strategic thinking, and ability to compete at the highest level of chess.
